description: background-origin and background-clip pick the boxes: a gradient placed in the content box and clipped to the padding box.

florui.css: .box { box-sizing: border-box; width: 120px; height: 80px; padding: 14px; border: 8px solid #5a5a5a; background-image: linear-gradient(to right, #ff5a5f, #ffd166); background-origin: content-box; background-clip: padding-box; background-repeat: no-repeat; }

classification.reason: Chromium dithers gradients, so a smooth gradient differs from this engine by one level of 255 on a third of its pixels (max error 1, mean about 0.3); channel_tolerance 2 stops that from counting. Measured against desktop Chrome: nothing differs by more than 2 levels, geometry an exact match.
